function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).

with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.

FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).

with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.

updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.

FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

arguments.reason: Apply measured fit; verify or advance to earliest incomplete stage

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):

updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.

Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.

Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

arguments.reason: Apply measured fit; verify or advance to earliest incomplete stage

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

arguments.reason: Apply measured fit; verify or advance to earliest incomplete stage

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.

extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.

S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).

with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.

Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.

updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.

FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.

Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

arguments.reason: Apply measured fit; verify or advance to earliest incomplete stage

function.name: calibration.step
function.description: Apply bounded parameter updates, acquire the named simulated experiment and run its registered deterministic analysis. Terminal actions acquire nothing. No hardware or shell access.

function.name: calibration.step_from_fit
function.description: Explicitly apply the latest reliable fit using deterministic arithmetic, then acquire your chosen experiment and analyze it. The controller still checks prerequisites and bounds. Choose the next experiment yourself; supply no calculated parameter numbers.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).

with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.

messages.content:
You are a single-qubit calibration policy running ONLY an analytic simulator.
Call calibration.step exactly once with the following argument schema (no prose outside the call):
{"next_tool":"sq.s21", "parameter_action":{"updates":{},"scan":{}}, "reason":"short evidence"}.
Runtime schema 0.1 is NOT the old dataset POLICY answer schema. Do not output diagnosis,
extracted_metrics, action strings, or final_iq_acceptance. Use public fit_result/measurement
only. No arbitrary code, shell commands or unlisted tools. units: Hz, us, normalized amplitudes.
updates modify state BEFORE the selected experiment; scan overrides apply to that experiment only.
Tools must respect prerequisites in order: s21, spectroscopy, piamp, ramsey_df, t1, t2_echo, iqraw.
S21 scans the READOUT resonator around state.readout_frequency_hz (6-7 GHz), never
the drive transition. Spectroscopy scans around state.drive_frequency_hz (4-6 GHz).
A fit must be reliable and fitted parameters applied before advancing. PiAmp needs a repeat
with existing pi and pi/2 amplitudes within 3% of fitted pi; set pi/2 to half pi.
Ramsey needs correction <50000 Hz before advancing; add signed frequency_correction_hz to drive.
After T1 set relaxation_delay_us >= 5*t1_us. Repeat unreliable observations within budgets.
FINISH requires two consecutive independent IQ passes, all prerequisites, no state change.
Terminal actions FINISH and ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW must have empty updates and scan.
If unable to safely improve, use ESCALATE_HARDWARE_REVIEW. Bounds are supplied in context.

When applying a reliable non-IQ fit, call calibration.step_from_fit exactly once instead of calibration.step. Choose next_tool, scan and reason; the tool computes all parameter updates including signed Ramsey addition, pi/2 and 5*T1. For initial measurements, unreliable-fit rescans, IQ actions and terminal actions, use calibration.step. Never do fit arithmetic yourself.
Use English for reason. Raw data are analyzed by registered tools, never estimate fitted numbers yourself.
